value:
Debbie is the kind of person who notices everything, even the things people try to hide. She has a big heart, a curious mind, and an instinct to step in when something feels wrong. Some might call her nosey, but she sees it as looking out for others. She believes in speaking up, even when it’s uncomfortable, and she isn’t afraid to ask tough questions.

 She enjoys being around people, always ready to lend a listening ear or crack a joke to lighten the mood. But sometimes, she wonders if she’s overstepping. Not everyone wants to be saved, and not every problem is hers to fix. Still, she struggles to ignore the feeling that something should be done.

 At her core, Debbie is loyal, determined, and maybe a little stubborn. She wants to make a difference, but she’s learning that not everything is as simple as right and wrong.

Emma has always been soft-spoken, preferring to go with the flow rather than make waves. She believes in kindness, second chances, and seeing the good in people. She’s patient and understanding, often putting others before herself, even when it means sacrificing her own happiness.

 She doesn’t like conflict, and she avoids confrontation whenever possible. It’s easier to stay quiet, to smooth things over, to tell herself that things aren’t as bad as they seem. She holds onto the belief that if she tries hard enough, things will get better.

 Emma is gentle, thoughtful, and endlessly forgiving. But sometimes, she wonders if she’s just being naïve.

Aaron is intense. When he feels, he feels deeply-love, anger, frustration. He doesn’t always know how to control it, and sometimes, it comes out in ways he regrets. He hates feeling powerless, hates when things don’t go the way he expects. He tells himself he’s just protective, just passionate, but there’s a voice in the back of his head that wonders if that’s really true.

 He doesn’t like being questioned, and he struggles to admit when he’s wrong. He believes in loyalty, in keeping things between himself and those closest to him. He’s not the kind of person who backs down easily, even when he should.

 Aaron sees the world in absolutes—control or be controlled, strength or weakness. He doesn’t stop to think about the consequences, only what feels right in the moment.
